## Definition of Done
See [docs/definition-of-done.md](https://github.com/GymGym-A-Project/GymGym-A-SE3003/blob/main/docs/definition-of-done.md) for how each item is verified. Tick a box only after the check is done; write "N/A" with a reason if an item does not apply.

- [ ] (a) Code compiles without warnings and follows the Flutter/Dart lint rules (CI: `dart format` check, `flutter analyze --fatal-infos`)
- [ ] (b) Feature passes all Work Package acceptance criteria on an Android/iOS emulator
- [ ] (c) PR reviewed and approved by at least one teammate (Tech Lead or QA Lead)
- [ ] (d) Unit/validation tests pass (mandatory for plateau detection rules and the AI whitelist filter)
- [ ] (e) Mandatory attributions ("© Gym visual" and the AI "Advisory only — not medical advice" notice) kept on the relevant screens
- [ ] (f) Related GitHub Project Board card moved to Done with the PR evidence link
